criteria.statement: An owned Bahia sidecar publishes compatible kind 30317 runtime=openclaw capability announcements without requiring upstream OpenClaw modifications.

The sidecar accepts only signed, addressed kind 38384 soulfactory.* requests from trusted SoulFactory controller pubkeys and validates schema, tags, content, signature, addressing, idempotency, and correlation before side effects.
The sidecar drives OpenClaw through an owned local command-driver seam rather than a SoulFactory REST lifecycle API or upstream OpenClaw patch dependency.
The sidecar publishes signed, correlated kind 38386 results for provision and lifecycle requests.
The sidecar preserves event-native behavior with scoped subscriptions, EOSE backfill transition, OK-enforced publication, and no polling or sleep-based completion semantics.
